reviewOf: DR-204 — V1/coop invariant coverage: newest-head heuristics and baseline-only standing could promote candidates or hide blockers/divergences; corrected posture is exact-selector/digest validation
verdictScope: The DR-204 correction itself — replacing newest-head heuristics and baseline-only standing with exact-selector/digest validation — is verified sound and implemented in the four subject files. Every adversarial re-measurement this review performed was caught or answerable by the pinned apparatus: drifted pins failed loudly (3/31), intact pins verified (28/31, 37/37), selector digests reproduced exactly (5/5 spot-checked), pinned executions reproduced byte-exactly (2/2, twice each), and every defect this review confirms was either already self-disclosed by the apparatus or is a correctable record defect enumerated below with a route. No finding rejects the corrected posture. Acceptance closes the DR-204 re-review gate only; it promotes nothing, and DR-001/DR-011 remain hard until the refresh and dispositions ruled below are executed and independently reviewed.

5-eir-v6-warrant.ruling: RECORDED DISPOSITION REQUIRED; APPLICATION NOT UNWOUND
5-eir-v6-warrant.facts: evidence-identity-recipes.v6 (bed154dc…) was APPLIED 2026-08-12 on a review whose verdict bytes read literally 'ACCEPT AS A CANDIDATE -- 0 BLOCKERS' (7a0d93e4…) — candidate-grade, an express reservation under the route-A acceptance property. That property (D-001 T2-02) was ADOPTED 2026-08-13, i.e., AFTER the application, and names v6 as one of three precedents proving '0 blockers' alone insufficient. On 2026-08-13, evidence-identity-recipes.v12 (f0bfaebd…) was applied under D-003 with the property's three conditions measured against its review (d5f748b2…, ACCEPT at 0 blockers, zero reservation-language hits) — the compliant contrast case — superseding v6. Freeze §7.3 continuation and D-003 both flag v6's warrant to this audit.
5-eir-v6-warrant.ruling_detail: The v6 application was not unlawful when made: no adopted rule then distinguished candidate-grade from application-grade acceptance, and the property is expressly prospective ('forbids prospectively'). But its standing is now an unenumerated residual: the corpus applied a head for ~1 day on a warrant class its standing rules now reject, and DR-011's own header forbids carrying residuals only in prose. Required: one dated disposition record — as a new DR-011 subledger row (per DR-011's new-residual rule) or an explicit LAWFULLY-DISPOSED note on the EIR lineage record — stating: (a) applied 2026-08-12 on candidate-grade ACCEPT, pre-property; (b) property prospective, application not unwound; (c) exposure window closed 2026-08-13 by v12's property-compliant supersession; (d) residual effect assessed nil on the recorded basis that the resolved canonical is byte-identical from v9 onward (872883db…, per D-003/freeze rider) and the v6→v12 resolved delta is prose corrections with every digest/pin/golden/recipe/vector byte-identical — a basis this review verified as RECORDED but did not independently re-resolve, so the disposition must cite D-003's evidence rather than this audit for it. Nothing here reopens v6's review, v12's application, or D-003.
